title: Pico vs Thunderhorn: cel-shaded anime fight from one character sheet
prompt_text:
TITLE: SUNSTONE SHOWDOWN: PICO VS THUNDERHORN

Create a 20-second premium cinematic 3D anime action-comedy fight in 16:9 widescreen format, rendered with crisp 4K-quality detail. The entire sequence takes place in one beautiful ancient mountain training courtyard in bright natural midday daylight. REFERENCE IMAGE: Use the uploaded combined character sheet as the strict visual reference for Pico and Thunderhorn. Preserve their exact facial features, body proportions, relative sizes, fur colors, costumes, horn shapes, tail anatomy, and weapon design in every shot. The character sheet defines appearance only. Do not reproduce its white background, poster typography, VS graphics or brushstroke elements in the animation. CHARACTER 1 — PICO: Pico is a small, quick-witted anthropomorphic fennec fox martial artist, approximately 1.25 meters tall. He has sandy-golden fur, an ivory muzzle and chest, huge expressive upright ears, dark brown eyes, a black nose, a single fluffy dark-tipped tail, and a compact agile build. He wears a sleeveless teal-blue training jacket over a cream T-shirt, dark brown tapered trousers, ivory wrist wraps and sand-colored training shoes. His fighting style is fast, playful, precise and acrobatic, emphasizing quick footwork, well-timed evasions, brief close-range counterattacks and constant spatial awareness. He is confident and mischievous, never reckless or frightened. CHARACTER 2 — THUNDERHORN: Thunderhorn is a massive anthropomorphic bighorn ram warrior, approximately 2.85 meters tall, with enormous muscular shoulders, thick arms, a barrel chest, powerful legs, dark walnut-brown fur, a lighter tan muzzle, and two huge symmetrical naturally curled ivory horns. He wears a sleeveless dark moss-green training tunic, a wide brown cloth belt, charcoal trousers, forearm wraps and rugged brown boots. His weapon is one long dark hardwood quarterstaff with rounded ends and a small leather center grip. Thunderhorn fights with heavy, powerful, committed staff attacks. His strength is overwhelming, but he is impatient and slow to correct his movements. His exaggerated expressions make his failed attacks entertaining. VISUAL STYLE: Premium cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, sophisticated Unreal Engine-quality rendering, thick expressive black character contours, controlled flat color blocking, clean hard-edged shadows, subtle hand-painted material texture, believable three-dimensional environments, high-quality character animation, and beautifully coordinated action choreography. Use natural colors, bright sunlit surfaces, physically grounded contact, realistic dust from footsteps, restrained motion blur during fast movements, dynamic but readable camera angles, and excellent facial acting. DAYLIGHT AND LIGHTING: It is approximately late morning under a clear blue sky. Strong clean sunlight illuminates the entire courtyard, producing naturally defined directional shadows across the stone floor. Warm sandstone surfaces reflect soft golden light into the characters. The distant mountains and sea remain naturally blue. Maintain consistent sunshine and shadow direction throughout. No nighttime atmosphere, neon lighting, colored glows, electric trails, artificial energy bursts, magical effects or luminous attacks. LOCATION: A wide circular martial-arts training courtyard constructed from honey-colored sandstone on a Mediterranean mountain ridge. The smooth open fighting floor is approximately twelve meters across, surrounded by low stone steps, old limestone arches, scattered olive trees beyond the courtyard, and a distant expansive view of the blue sea and rugged hills. The architecture is ancient but well maintained. On the rear-left boundary of the circular fighting area stands a large bronze training gong suspended vertically from a sturdy wooden A-frame fixed securely to the stone platform. Its round bronze face points toward the center of the arena, with the center approximately 1.5 meters above the floor. The gong must remain stationary in its location throughout the video, except for physically believable swinging after impact. GEOGRAPHY AND SCREEN DIRECTION: At the beginning, Pico stands near center-left of the fighting courtyard, while Thunderhorn stands several meters to his right. Thunderhorn advances primarily from screen right toward screen left. The gong is visible in the rear-left area behind Pico's side of the arena. During the fight, Pico gradually retreats toward that gong, setting up the final attack. All character movements, camera cuts and attack directions must preserve this spatial relationship. The courtyard never changes location, layout or orientation. The gong must appear in the establishing shot and remain in the same position whenever visible. ACTION SEQUENCE: 0:00–0:02 — THE CHALLENGE Open with a striking wide, low-angle cinematic shot of the beautiful sunlit courtyard, the blue sea in the distance, and both fighters facing each other. Thunderhorn stomps forward from the right, rotates his long wooden staff once with both hands and plants its lower end firmly onto the stone floor with a powerful dull thud. A small natural puff of dust rises. Pico, standing opposite him, raises one eyebrow, casually shifts into a relaxed fighting stance and gives a playful two-finger invitation. Thunderhorn scowls. Strong visual contrast between the giant's enormous mass and the fox's small agile body. 0:02–0:05 — THE FIRST SWEEP Thunderhorn lunges forward and sweeps his staff horizontally from his right to his left, directing the attack low across Pico's legs. Maintain the correct staff length and clear trajectory. Pico reacts instantly, springs vertically just high enough for the wooden staff to pass safely underneath his feet, and lands lightly slightly closer to Thunderhorn's front-right side. The staff continues through its natural arc without abruptly changing direction. A smooth side-tracking camera clearly reveals the complete movement. Thunderhorn realizes his attack missed and turns his head sharply toward the little fox. 0:05–0:08 — THE FOX STRIKES BACK Taking advantage of being inside the long staff's effective striking range, Pico rushes in toward Thunderhorn's exposed lower torso and delivers two exceptionally quick, precise open-palm martial-arts strikes. The first contacts the giant's lower ribs, and the second lands against his abdomen. The attacks produce two satisfying stylized impact sounds but do not unrealistically launch the huge ram backward. Thunderhorn merely flinches, bends slightly in surprise and looks down in disbelief. Pico immediately springs back out of reach, landing balanced on both feet with a cheeky grin. Use a quick medium shot for the strikes and a tight expressive reaction shot on Thunderhorn's offended face. 0:08–0:11 — THE HEAVY COUNTER Thunderhorn's expression changes from surprise to furious determination. He adjusts his two-handed grip and lifts the wooden staff high before driving it down diagonally toward the stone directly in front of Pico. Pico spots the trajectory, pivots sharply and performs one clean sideways evasive roll toward the rear-left side of the courtyard. The staff strikes the exposed sandstone floor where Pico stood a fraction of a second earlier, producing a deep wooden crack, a small grounded dust burst and a visible jolt through Thunderhorn's arms. The staff remains intact and firmly in his hands. Pico completes the roll and rises smoothly into a crouched ready stance. 0:11–0:14 — THE SETUP Pico notices the large bronze gong behind him near the rear-left perimeter. His ears perk up and a mischievous smile spreads across his face. Keeping his eyes on Thunderhorn, he takes several quick backward steps toward the gong, positioning himself approximately one meter directly in front of its bronze face. The gong is visibly aligned behind Pico along the line from Thunderhorn's weapon. Thunderhorn mistakes Pico's retreat for fear and advances aggressively, holding the staff horizontally in both hands. Cut between a clear wide shot showing the fox, ram and gong in one continuous spatial arrangement, and a brief close-up of Pico's confident smile. 0:14–0:17 — THE GONG STRIKE Thunderhorn plants his leading foot and commits to one powerful forward staff thrust, aiming at Pico's upper body. Pico waits until the direction of the staff is clearly established, then makes a fast sideways step diagonally toward the camera, leaving the weapon's path completely clear. Unable to stop the committed thrust in time, Thunderhorn drives the rounded tip of his wooden staff directly into the large bronze gong behind Pico. The impact produces an enormous resonant metallic BOOOONG that reverberates through the open mountain courtyard. The gong swings backward slightly on its real suspension points, then starts oscillating naturally. Thunderhorn keeps both hands on the staff and recoils in astonishment, his massive ears twitching and his eyes widening. The staff does not pass through the gong, and the wooden supporting frame remains standing and intact. Capture the impact with a dramatic three-quarter wide shot followed by a brief close-up of the ram's shocked expression. No graphic shockwaves or artificial energy rings. 0:17–0:20 — THE FINAL HUMILIATION Still embarrassed by the deafening gong strike, Thunderhorn reflexively yanks his staff backward too forcefully, overbalances and takes two clumsy backward steps toward the center of the arena before dropping harmlessly onto his backside on the flat stone floor. He keeps hold of the same intact wooden staff. Pico, who has remained just to the side of the gong, steps into view beside him, folds his arms, tilts his head and gives a tiny exaggerated martial-arts bow with a smug smile. Thunderhorn stares at the little fox in disbelief, his pride completely defeated, while the bronze gong continues gently swaying behind them. Finish on a beautifully composed wide shot of both characters, the ancient courtyard and the brilliant sunny mountain landscape. The lingering gong resonance provides the final comedic beat. CAMERA AND CINEMATOGRAPHY: Use the visual language of a premium animated fighting-game cinematic. Begin with a wide establishing shot and strong low-angle character introduction. Alternate between lateral tracking shots that show full-body movement, carefully timed medium shots, selective facial close-ups, clean three-quarter angles and wide shots for major impacts. Keep the screen direction of attacks readable. Preserve spatial relationships between the characters and gong at every cut. Avoid chaotic camera shaking, excessive zooming, rapid random edits, unnecessary slow motion, or repeated camera compositions. Important strikes must be visually understandable before impact occurs. Emphasize physical momentum, smooth recovery movements, grounded foot placement, clear weapon arcs and expressive silhouettes. AUDIO: Create a lively premium cinematic martial-arts action-comedy soundtrack featuring rhythmic acoustic percussion, low dramatic drums, subtle orchestral accents and playful rhythmic breaks. Add detailed natural sound design: footfalls on sandstone, cloth movement, realistic staff whooshes, wooden impacts, quick palm strikes, physical landings, subtle wind in the open courtyard and distant outdoor ambience. The gigantic bronze gong impact at 0:14–0:17 must be the signature audio moment, with a powerful resonant strike followed by a gradually fading metallic ring. Briefly reduce the music volume during the gong sound to emphasize its comedic impact, then end with a playful closing musical beat. No dialogue, spoken words, screaming, narration or vocals. PHYSICAL AND VISUAL CONSISTENCY: Exactly two visible living characters throughout. Thunderhorn always has exactly two symmetrical horns and one identical wooden staff. Pico always has two large ears and one fluffy dark-tipped tail. No character duplicates, disappearing limbs, morphing fur patterns or costume changes. Thunderhorn's staff must stay the same length and shape in every shot. The staff must remain visibly controlled by Thunderhorn's hands, including during the gong strike and final stumble. Pico never suddenly acquires a weapon. The gong must exist from the opening establishing shot, remain fixed to its wooden support and react naturally when struck. Avoid impossible body rotations, floating characters, unsupported landings, extreme unnatural stretches, physical clipping, weapon teleportation and discontinuous character positions. The action must feel fast, clever, tightly choreographed, physically clear and visually exciting. The comedy should emerge from timing, body language, size contrast and Thunderhorn's own momentum, not random slapstick or exaggerated supernatural effects. RENDERING: High-quality 4K cinematic presentation, 16:9 widescreen, premium clean cel-shaded 3D anime aesthetics, beautiful daylight, warm sandstone colors, strong natural depth, beautiful blue sky and consistent polished lighting. No blood, no gore, no serious injuries, no destruction of the environment, no extra fighters, no magic, no neon effects, no glowing trails, no floating particles unrelated to physical movement, no subtitles, no titles, no on-screen text, no watermarks, no scene transitions to other locations, and no sudden artistic style changes.

title: Dragon joins the medieval kitchen
prompt_text: Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic fantasy video set in a rustic medieval village kitchen, featuring a young blonde woman with braided hair, wearing a cream blouse and a dark brown apron, alongside a magnificent white dragon with pale pink spikes, glowing amber eyes, and highly detailed scales. Scene 1 (0–5 seconds): A wide establishing shot of the woman preparing food at a rustic wooden table outside a medieval cottage. A giant white dragon slowly approaches her from behind, curiously observing the food. Warm golden sunlight streams through the village, creating a magical atmosphere. Scene 2 (5–10 seconds): Close-up of the dragon's glowing amber eye as it opens its mouth and breathes a powerful burst of fire toward the cooking area. The woman reacts with shock and quickly moves away from the flames. Sparks, smoke, and realistic fire effects fill the scene. Scene 3 (10–15 seconds): The woman uses a metal pan to control the cooking fire while the dragon watches with curiosity. Smoke rises dramatically as the dragon lowers its enormous head beside her, creating a funny yet cinematic moment. Scene 4 (15–20 seconds): Inside a cozy medieval kitchen illuminated by flickering candlelight, the woman carefully prepares a piece of roasted meat on a wooden table. The giant white dragon rests its head beside her, watching every movement with intense curiosity. Use intimate close-ups and warm amber lighting. Scene 5 (20–25 seconds): The woman holds a small flame near the dragon's snout. Capture an extreme close-up of its beautiful golden eye reflecting the firelight. She tastes the freshly cooked meat, smiles, and gestures approvingly toward the dragon. Scene 6 (25–30 seconds): The woman and the dragon share a playful, heartwarming moment beside the dinner table. The dragon gently lowers its enormous head toward her while she continues eating. End with a wide cinematic shot of the medieval kitchen, warm candlelight, rustic wooden furniture, and the dragon curling around the room. Visual Style: Photorealistic fantasy, Hollywood-level CGI, cinematic composition, realistic dragon anatomy, highly detailed skin and scales, natural facial expressions, physically accurate fire and smoke, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movements, dramatic close-ups, warm golden color grading, realistic textures, 4K quality. Camera: Smooth tracking shots, wide establishing shots, extreme close-ups, slow cinematic push-ins, and seamless transitions. Audio: Natural kitchen ambience, crackling fire, subtle dragon breathing and growls, sizzling meat, and cinematic fantasy background music. Format: 16:9 widescreen, 30 seconds, 24 FPS, consistent character design, consistent dragon appearance, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks.

title: 15-second continuous-shot cosmic astronaut film
prompt_text:
Create a breathtaking **15-second continuous-shot surreal cosmic action film**, vertical 3:4, ultra-photorealistic cinematic quality.

**CRITICAL CAMERA DIRECTION:** The entire sequence must feel like one uninterrupted, fluid camera take. No hard cuts, jump cuts, abrupt perspective changes, or sudden location transitions. Use graceful tracking, smooth camera arcs, continuous forward momentum, and natural foreground occlusion to connect every event. The camera follows the same astronaut throughout, maintaining consistent screen direction and spatial continuity. All transformations happen visibly within the same evolving environment.

**0–3 SECONDS — THE REVERSAL** The camera floats alongside a lone astronaut in a detailed white spacesuit with a reflective golden visor as he falls through towering storm clouds. Lightning softly illuminates the clouds. Gravity gradually reverses, slowing his descent before smoothly accelerating him upward. The camera curves beneath him and follows his upward motion. As he rises, the surrounding clouds become translucent, revealing a vast ocean suspended in the sky.

**3–6 SECONDS — THE LIVING SKY** Without cutting, the camera glides behind the astronaut as he passes between two enormous whales swimming through the clouds. One whale gracefully crosses overhead, its tail sweeping close to the astronaut. The camera gently banks with his evasive movement. A flowing stream of luminous jellyfish surrounds him, their glowing bodies naturally filling the foreground. As the camera passes through the jellyfish, their soft light reveals a gigantic moon ahead.

**6–10 SECONDS — THE COSMIC TSUNAMI** The camera continues tracking the astronaut toward the enormous moon. Glowing cracks spread across its surface, and massive fragments slowly separate before accelerating outward. A brilliant wave of liquid starlight pours through the opening and begins rushing toward the astronaut. He curves away from the approaching wave, and the camera smoothly follows his turn, keeping both the astronaut and the expanding cosmic tsunami visible. The floating moon fragments naturally form a rotating circular passage in his escape path.

**10–13 SECONDS — THE FLOWING ESCAPE** The astronaut accelerates through the circular opening between the moon fragments. The camera follows directly behind, banking gently through the same opening. The cosmic wave surges through the gap immediately afterward, filling the background with sparkling particles. As the camera emerges, the glowing particles gradually become floating droplets of water. The surrounding cosmic environment continuously transforms into an immense inverted ocean overhead.

**13–15 SECONDS — THE FINAL REVEAL** The astronaut gradually slows beneath the upside-down ocean. The camera gently pulls backward and upward, revealing a colossal bioluminescent whale emerging downward from the water above him. Its glowing body illuminates the astronaut while distant moon fragments remain suspended in the background. End with a graceful, uninterrupted wide composition emphasizing the tiny astronaut beneath the enormous whale.

**VISUAL STYLE:** Premium cinematic realism, elegant camera choreography, seamless environmental morphing, physically convincing astronaut movement, natural whale animation, volumetric clouds, realistic water, blue-violet bioluminescence, golden moonlight, immense cosmic scale, controlled motion blur, fluid visual effects.

**AUDIO:** Continuous atmospheric soundscape that evolves naturally with the visuals. Rushing wind transitions into deep underwater resonance, distant whale calls blend into cosmic vibrations, the moon fracture produces a rising bass rumble, and the final ocean reveal fades into peaceful ambient silence. Smooth audio crossfades, no abrupt sound changes.

**STRICT CONTINUITY:** One astronaut, one continuous camera journey, one evolving environment. No hard cuts, teleportation, sudden background replacement, discontinuous camera angles, jerky camera motion, frozen animation, duplicated subjects, or abrupt visual transformations. Prioritize seamless cinematic flow over excessive action.
